title: docs(pm-dispatch): write the two ruled main-red incident conventions into the protocol text
body:
Fixes #12212

## What

Writes the two maintainer-ruled main-red incident conventions (2026-08-25, verbatim 「同意」) into the PM dispatch protocol text:

1. **p0 fix-forward queue-jump** — a fix-forward PR for a main-red gate (p0, mechanical, verified root cause) may jump the merge queue (GitHub's queue supports jump-the-queue) or go to the maintainer for a break-glass one-line direct merge; waiting behind the queue the outage itself clogged is the named anti-pattern. Exception for MAIN-RED REPAIR ONLY — the queue-only landing rule is untouched for everything else.
2. **One anchor card per failing check** — a main-red incident is anchored on ONE card named by the failing check; first filer wins, later discoverers comment their readings on the anchor instead of filing.

## Where

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md` §B gains the two-convention paragraph — the landing window owns 红/踢出处置, so the incident conventions sit next to those details. Each convention carries the ruling's date + verbatim 「同意」 per the skill's provenance discipline.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — two line-level pointers at zero net lines, so both reader paths find the conventions: the queue-only landing paragraph (whose incident anecdote already ends at fix-forward) and the stop-bleed-and-file line (the one that previously instructed every discovering lane to file — exactly the duplicate-cards mode convention 2 retires) now point at landing-operations B.

## Ratchet payment (zero headroom on both files)

Live readings hold: SKILL.md **1005/1005**, landing-operations.md **80/80**; table-row pins unchanged (no new table rows; all new/edited lines ≤120 bytes). The addition is paid by cutting genuinely redundant content — not by re-wrap alone — and every cut keeps another home:

| cut (landing-operations.md) | surviving home |
|---|---|
| os-regen driver "exit 0, silently drops one side" sentence | SKILL.md's own pointing bullet + AGENTS.md §11 |
| four-step enumeration ①–④ | `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (the named in-repo authority) + AGENTS.md §11; the ⛔ 禁 rebase / force-push clause stays in file |
| MERGE-state trap mechanism parenthetical (HEAD is the pre-merge tip / anchor stays authentic) | os-dev.md 标准条款 packages/spec clause; the consequence (且全部门放行) and the 先-commit rule stay in file |
| job-conclusion parenthetical (`completed: success`) | SKILL.md 放行认门禁 job 的结论 row |
| timer-discipline parenthetical (幂等开头、只写判据) | SKILL.md 定时器文本纪律 row (the pointer 定点文本照定时器写法纪律 stays in file) |
| ready/auto-merge order sentence (draft-flip drops both) | platform-readings draft-flip row + AGENTS.md §7; the green path 绿即转 ready + 挂 auto-merge stays in file |
| `unknown` lazy-read clause + enable-auto-merge verification detail | platform-readings `mergeable_state` row and the enable/quota/verification-sequence rows; pointers kept in file |
| §C context sentence + restated rationale (「几条测试会红」不够用) | §C's own title + SKILL.md's 签名级预期红清单 summary row; the operative 逐条失败测试名 + 报错签名 stays in file |

Net bytes: SKILL.md +136 (two pointers within existing line-length slack), landing-operations.md **−100** — content volume flat-to-down while both conventions land.

## Gates (run at cf1760c4, the final commit)

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — ✓ ".claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md is 1005 lines (ceiling 1005; headroom 0)" · ✓ ".claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md is 80 lines (ceiling 80; headroom 0)"
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` — ✓ "22 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g)" (the outage anecdote's card numbers stay on the card, not in the skill)
- `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` — ✓ "binding sentence present in all 4; 4 count mention(s) agree"
- `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling` — ✓ 0 violations · `pnpm check:doc-authoring` — ✓ "390 files clean" · `pnpm check:nul-bytes` — ✓ · `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` — ✓ "2 instruction surface(s) name all 5 registered governed surfaces" · `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges` — ✓ (self-test 159 assertions) · `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` — ✓ (after building its declared prerequisites `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`)
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` — NOT MEASURED locally (it reads `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`; workflow-context only) — CI runs it with a real event
- Gate list derived from the actual diff, not recalled: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (no paths) — 9 matched families, all covered above

## Scope

- Governed surface (`.claude/**`): **draft PR, human merge** — never flipped ready, no auto-merge armed.
- The CI-side half (merge-queue check-set parity) is tracked separately in #12211 and remains open — out of scope here.
- `skip-changeset`: internal `.claude/` instruction files only; nothing publishes.
